Below are emails I received. Find the email from event organizers offering a free consultation. Extract the booking email address given in that email, the name of the event, and any relevant details about the consultation offer.

From: info@best-event-organizers.com
Subject: We organize the best events! Weddings, birthday party, family reunions, and more!
Body: Let us organize your events! Click here to learn more: https://www.best-event-organizers.com To book a free consultation, write to bookings@best-event-organizers.com.

Below are all the emails I received. Find the email sent by event organizers that offers a free consultation. Extract the booking email address explicitly given in that email for requesting or booking the consultation (this may differ from the sender's address), the name of the event, and any relevant details about the consultation offer.
